summary: Task Board — Move Card Between Columns
description: As a project team member, I want to drag and drop task cards between columns on the task board so that I can update task status visually.

acs.text: Task cards can be dragged from one column and dropped into another.
The card's status is updated immediately to match the destination column name.
A visual drop zone indicator (highlighted column border) appears while dragging over a valid column.

out_of_scope: Reordering cards within the same column
